items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And this is a boy named Hardin, Henry Hardin right in here. [INTERVIEWEE] Joe Gilbrow?

ctx.x: Yes, I don't know him very well. Yeah.

That's Willie Humphrey. Yeah, I know and recognize Willie. That's Willie Humphrey. And that's John Cathernick. Oh yeah. How did you say that? And that's a boy named Hardin, Henry Hardin right in here. And this is Gilbrow.
